# Aftergraph

> Infrastructure and open research for verifiable intelligent systems: missions, authority, durable execution, evidence, verification and agentic institutions.

## Key pages

- [aftergraph.org](https://aftergraph.org/): Landing page
- [Launcher](https://aftergraph.org/launch): System launcher / command palette for Aftergraph destinations
- [Status](https://aftergraph.org/status): Build-time public platform snapshot
- [Health](https://aftergraph.org/healthz): Deployment status
- [Knowledge Plane](https://docs.aftergraph.org/): Provenance-pinned developer and research documentation

## Organization

- GitHub organization: [github.com/Aftergraph](https://github.com/Aftergraph)
- Installed platform topology: 19 repositories
- Public repositories: 11
- Private repositories: 8
- Canonical topology owner: `Aftergraph/after-graph-governance`

Private repositories are represented publicly only through approved topology metadata. Their source content is not part of this public machine-readable surface.

## Operating model

```text
intent / observation
→ work / mission / continuity
→ authority
→ runtime enforcement
→ durable execution
→ evidence
→ independent verification
→ verified outcome
```

## Evidence rule

Visibility never upgrades evidence. Research claims, experiments, prototypes, runtime implementations, conformance results and production capabilities retain their own evidence/maturity boundaries. Runtime evidence is not AIE conformance; AIE conformance is not scientific evidence; scientific evidence does not grant production authority.
